folds.allocation: rank by digest of UTF-8 salt/homonym, tie by homonym, then rank modulo fold count

features: identical to v2, with form scaling fit within each original-training fit partition

objective.ordinal: v2 summed per-item histogram cross-entropy and intercept-exempt L2
objective.effect: beta * N / (2 * M) * sum(((predicted signed difference - observed signed difference) / 4)^2)
objective.relative_pair_order: later - earlier by opaque ending ID for the same family and sense

solver.initialization: zero for beta=0, that fold beta=0 optimum for beta>0

selection.score: lowest pooled out-of-fold signed-update MAE, tie by smallest beta
selection.eligibility: positive beta converges in all folds and strictly improves MAE versus beta=0

dev_gates.effect_ending_minus_effect_prefix: paired 95% CI upper bounds below zero for NLL and update MAE
dev_gates.effect_ending_minus_baseline_ending: paired 95% CI upper below zero for update MAE and below NLL margin
dev_gates.effect_amplitude_minus_human: paired 90% CI entirely inside the open equivalence bounds
